mapper.insert: insert into risk_alert_log ( rule_id, company_id, event_id, alert_level, alert_title, alert_content, is_notified, create_time ) values ( #{ruleId}, #{companyId}, #{eventId}, #{alertLevel}, #{alertTitle}, #{alertContent}, #{isNotified}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from risk_alert_log where id in #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_alert_log WHERE is_handled = 0
SELECT alert_level as alertLevel, COUNT(*) as count FROM risk_alert_log GROUP BY alert_level ORDER BY alert_level
select a.*, c.company_name from risk_alert_log a left join risk_company c on a.company_id = c.id order by a.create_time desc limit #{limit}
